description: okWOW session capture: saves your agent sessions as okWOW chats. Each app's first session opens okWOW once to sign that app in; nothing is sent before that.

hooks.command: py=; for p in python3 python; do if "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3,))' >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=$p; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$py" ]; then echo 'okWOW capture: no working Python 3 interpreter found (tried python3, python). Install Python 3 and restart.' >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$py" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/okwow-capture" hook
